# Open Weight Models

> Independent reference for open-weight AI models, licenses, hardware, inference, deployment and structured model data.

Canonical site: https://openweightmodels.github.io/
GitHub organization: https://github.com/openweightmodels
Structured model data: https://openweightmodels.github.io/data/models.json

## Core concept
Open-weight models are AI models whose trained parameters are made available for download and self-managed inference. Weight availability does not automatically imply open training data, open training code, commercial rights or a standard open-source license.

## Primary sections
- Definition: https://openweightmodels.github.io/#definition
- Models: https://openweightmodels.github.io/#models
- Licenses: https://openweightmodels.github.io/#licenses
- Hardware: https://openweightmodels.github.io/#hardware
- Inference: https://openweightmodels.github.io/#inference
- FAQ: https://openweightmodels.github.io/#faq

## Editorial policy
Prefer primary sources and model-specific license documents. Verify model-specific facts before production use.
